answer: According to the building record, Lord Aeck Sargent and The Miller Hull Partnership were the architecture firms involved in the design of the Kendeda Building. Skanska USA served as the construction company for this project. The building is a sustainable design center, as evidenced by the surrounding garden and the covered structure above it. The building reached substantial completion and soft launch in fall 2019, with classes beginning in January 2020 and Living Building Challenge certification achieved in March 2021.
